gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-hk: Gugi stands tall and bold, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals. Noto Sans HK, a sans with large lowercase forms and lifted brush ends, keeps whole paragraphs moving without any tiring drag.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-imperial-aramai: Strokes of constant width, like bent pipe, give Gugi its bold look, with tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic gives the pipe-bent heading a friendly, pincer-ended sans partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-p: Ruler-straight line weight runs through every Gugi letter, with tall lowercase nearly matching the capitals. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian offers a deep middle band and big-eyed sans forms, the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-jp: Gugi gives its n arches the full strength of the stems, with terminals cut open. But Noto Sans JP is plain sans with a very tall x-height and curves that sweep open.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Gugi keeps its thin joins no thinner than the stems, giving the display face a bold look. And Noto Sans Kaithi, plain sans with an open e, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Noto Sans Kayah Li reads as plain sans-serif text, with lifted brush ends and capitals barely taller than its lowercase. Gugi shouts above it with neon-tube strokes while the text stays quiet.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Dark, friendly lines of text, with curves that never close back on themselves, sit beneath the blunt marker feel of Gugi. Noto Sans Kharoshthi supplies the sans texture while the heading keeps things bold.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Gugi moves its curves and stems in lockstep, giving the heading a tall, bold, distinctive look. Then Noto Sans Khojki steps in with a large-eyed e and exits wide enough for light.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Gugi runs a single track width, like a neon sign tube, while its lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Noto Sans Limbu feels gaping and tall-bodied beside it, a friendly sans foil.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-lydian: A flat, unvarying line weight marks every letter of Gugi, bold and distinctive. But Noto Sans Lydian has capitals barely taller than lowercase and a sprung paper clip of an opening.
